full_judgment: 25. "Revision of decrees and orders of Courts of Small Causes. The High Court, for the purpose of satisfying itself that a decree or order made in any case decided by a Court of Small Causes was according to law, may call for the case and pass such order with respect thereto as it thinks fit."
